description: 8.1.7 at UTC+05:45. A fixed day aligns to midnight at the window's offset, so the boundary is at 18:15Z. A quarter-hour offset is in the corpus because an implementation that divided by whole hours would pass every other case in this suite.
clock_note: 2026-01-01T18:15:00Z, which is 2026-01-02T00:00:00 at UTC+05:45 — the first instant of a local day

requests.note: 2026-01-02T18:14:59Z — the last second of that local day.
2026-01-02T18:15:00Z — one second on, and a new local day.
The boundary is where the offset puts it, not where UTC midnight is.
